categories.main_business_segments: The company and its subsidiaries primarily engage in manufacturing and sales of solar photovoltaic industry materials, including solar cell conductive solder ribbons and conductive pastes, as well as operating solar power plants. They also develop and produce semiconductor silicon wafers, low-temperature specialty chemical materials, and micro-tools for the electronics industry. Additionally, the company is involved in renewable energy system engineering and energy storage solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include materials science focusing on powder materials, precision processing, polymers, glass materials, semiconductor materials, and vacuum technology. The company develops high-efficiency solar conductive pastes and solder ribbons, diamond-coated micro-diameter cutting wires for silicon wafers, low-temperature curing conductive silver pastes, and advanced semiconductor wafer processing including polishing and cleaning. They also apply physical vapor deposition for micro-tool surface treatment and develop AI-driven high-efficiency heat dissipation components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are solar cell manufacturers, semiconductor companies, and electronics component producers. The company serves global markets with a focus on Asia, including Taiwan and China, and exports to other regions such as the Americas and Europe. Their products support solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, semiconductor wafer users, and emerging markets in renewable energy and energy storage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and manufacturing are primarily based in Taiwan, with subsidiaries and investments in China, Southeast Asia (Philippines), Mauritius, Seychelles, Samoa, Singapore, and Japan. The company serves global markets, with significant sales in Asia, and exports to the Americas and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the solar photovoltaic supply chain, supplying key materials such as conductive pastes and solder ribbons to solar cell manufacturers. It also extends downstream by investing in and operating solar power plants and energy storage systems, integrating vertically to provide end-to-end renewable energy solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-efficiency solar cell materials, especially N-type TopCon conductive pastes and solder ribbons, expanding renewable energy investments including solar power plants and energy storage, and diversifying into semiconductor and biomedical specialty materials. R&D focuses on improving material performance, reducing costs, and developing advanced processing technologies such as diamond wire cutting and micro-structured heat dissipation components. The company also emphasizes sustainability and compliance with environmental standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of solar conductive pastes, solder ribbons, semiconductor wafers, and specialty chemical materials. Additional income comes from engineering services for solar power systems, operation and sale of electricity from solar power plants, and licensing or technology cooperation agreements. The company also benefits from investment returns in renewable energy projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with leading solar material suppliers, including major Chinese manufacturers, in a highly competitive market characterized by price pressure and rapid technological innovation. It holds an estimated 8-15% global market share in solar conductive pastes. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, cost control, and vertical integration into solar power plant operations, positioning as a comprehensive renewable energy materials and solutions provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.9 billion in the latest fiscal year, a significant increase from the previous year. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss of about NT$301 million. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around NT$16 billion and continues to invest in R&D and renewable energy projects. Cash flow from financing activities increased due to bond issuance and bank loans to support expansion. The company is focused on stabilizing profitability and expanding its renewable energy footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, cost-effective solar materials that enhance solar cell efficiency, such as advanced conductive pastes and solder ribbons tailored for next-generation N-type solar cells. It offers integrated renewable energy solutions combining materials supply, system engineering, and power plant operation to provide stable and sufficient green electricity with certification to meet international carbon reduction standards. Its strong R&D and vertical integration create competitive advantages in quality, innovation, and sustainability.
